**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Miss Yonge would be much obliged if [Messrs Macmillan](../others.html#111) would send a copy of each of her works to the [Vnble Archdeacon Badnell](../persons.html#90)[^1]
Care of H J Dunell Esq
4 Upper Hyde Park Gardens W[^2]

[^1]: The Ven.

Hopkins Badnall (1821- 1892) was Archdeacon of George in South Africa, and later Bishop of Cape Town, which accounts for his correspondence being forwarded. CMY was probably presenting the books to a school.

[^2]: On the reverse is a list of book titles in CMY’s writing: ‘History of Christian Names/ The Heir of Redclyffe/ Dynevor Terrace/ Daisy Chain/ Heartsease/ Hopes and Fears/ Young Stepmother/ Lances of Lynwood/ Little Duke / Marie Theresè of Lamourous’.

These have been ticked in pencil and \'sent by I.D.C.

Sept 5’ is noted.
